text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Democratic parties unseat (Basque separatists' ETA political wing) Herri Batasuna from their most emblematic town council
- Development Ministry approved the purchase of Antena 3 before the deal was signed
- "Super" petrol price reaches new record of 122.9 pesetas per litre
- Police in Granada arrest Italian mafia chief implicated in dozens of murders
EL MUNDO
- Democrats recover Mondragon town council amid HB insults and threats
DIARIO 16
- "I'm scared, but let's go on" - new mayor of Mondragon
ABC
- Today is the centenary of the murder of Canovas
LA VANGUARDIA
- HB loses symbolic town council in Mondragon
- New Retevision ends 73 years of Telefonica's monopoly
CINCO DIAS
- Retevision, alone versus Telefonica
- Agreed salaries grow by 50 percent more than inflation
- Saica builds his third paper company for 25 billion pesetas
- BBV, Argentaria bid for Mexico's Banpais
EXPANSION
- Government to raise (some administration) rates in 1998 by more than inflation
- Development Minister Arias Salgado: "We'll give Retevision our full support"
- Madrid stock market recovers 3.2 percent since Monday, back above 600
- Bank of England hikes rates 25 basis points, dollar slows its rise
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Development Ministry gives free rein to Retevision and asks it to cut telephone charges
- Bank of England hikes rates again and suggests a pause in the upward trend of the cycle
